metadata.description: Sujeet's personal Claude Code toolkit: reusable plugins for any codebase

plugins.name: kc-conventions
plugins.description: Portable coding conventions as path-scoped rules, installed into a project with /kc-conventions:kc-init

plugins.name: kc-gates
plugins.description: Gate-based code review: one gate agent per convention topic, per-box PASS/FAIL verdicts, zero rationalized skips

plugins.name: kc-instructions
plugins.description: Audit a repo's Claude Code instruction setup: what stays in CLAUDE.md, what becomes a path-scoped rule, a skill, or a hook

plugins.name: kc-verify
plugins.description: Verification workflows: look at the UI before calling it done, with realistic data across states, viewports and themes

plugins.name: kc-usage-band
plugins.description: A row of pills above the prompt: model, git branch, context fill, rate limits with reset times, token totals and session cost

plugins.name: kc-image-preview
plugins.description: Thumbnails of the images you paste, above the prompt, in any terminal; reads the real file behind a copied Finder icon

plugins.name: kc-autopilot
plugins.description: Plan in, PRs out: engineer, reviewer and persona-QA agents loop on each unit of an approved plan until it is clean
